description: Portable rules for premium modern web UI, motion, responsive behavior, accessibility, and anti-generic design.

payload.instruction: Choose a deliberate display/body type pairing or a distinctive single family; do not default to Inter, system-ui, or Arial without a reason.
Define a restrained semantic palette with explicit surface, text, muted, accent, border, and focus tokens; avoid generic purple gradients.
Establish a clear visual hierarchy using intentional section rhythm, asymmetric composition where appropriate, and a consistent spacing scale.
Add purposeful transitions for interactive state changes and restrained entrance motion; keep interactions responsive and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Design and test mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts; do not merely shrink desktop content and do not allow horizontal overflow.
Use visible focus states, semantic controls, accessible names, readable contrast, keyboard reachability, and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Prefer purposeful original or product-relevant visual assets; avoid decorative stock imagery and placeholder icon clutter.
Reuse the existing design tokens and components discovered in the target codebase before inventing competing primitives.
Before claiming completion, provide the changed files, applied rule IDs, rendered breakpoint evidence, and unresolved issues.
